frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: Yes... Yes, I remember now. I am Circuitus, master of the Rhythm Core. I will help you, friends.

frames.heading: Rhythm Core
frames.body: The Rhythm Core is Mother Board's heartbeat, a powerful device generating the planet's techno energy. Encased in a futuristic shell with rotating rings and a glowing crystalline center, it enhances the planet's techno music.

frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: The Rhythm Core is repaired. But to fully reactivate it, we need to create a Harmonic Convergence. The final step must be performed at the Central Hub.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: Here we are, The Central Hub. Mother Board awaits.

frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: To reactivate Mother Board, we must channel the Rhythm Core's energy into her mainframe. This requires a harmonic convergence. Both diodes and fuseons must synchronize their brats in perfect harmony.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: Fellow Diodes, remember the rhythm that once flowed through our circuits. Let us join together and revive the beats of Electronova!

frames.heading: Fuseon
frames.body: Fuseons, the traveller has awakened us to the power of groove. Let us unite with our Diode brethren and bring back the music!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Feel the music, let it guide you. Let's bring Mother Board back to life!
